pairs.subject: agent-browser-control
pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/studio/browser.ts:7 The Leonardo Studio code is hand-scripted Playwright over CDP: driver.ts fills the form from a fixed selector table and is called by producers and pipelines (scoutScene, music-video, keyframes). No agent is ever handed the browser as a command tool, so the subject's precondition (an agent driving a browser through a command surface) does not hold. An rg -i for ariaSnapshot, getByRole, mcp and tunnel over lib/imaging/{providers,studio,video} returned no hits, and nothing in app/_server/mcp references the studio browser.

techniques.evidence: lib/imaging/studio/selectors.ts:1 Engineers maintain the selectors in code. No agent composes or receives element references.
lib/imaging/studio/browser.ts:6 The code attaches to the operator's long-lived Chrome profile. There is no per-workspace agent daemon or state file, and none is needed.
lib/imaging/studio/driver.ts:29 Errors go to an operator or a pipeline. No agent reads them as recovery instructions.

pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/library/page.tsx:4 This context is a Next.js screen for browsing produced assets.
